entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
(Sighs heavily) Oh, I hope this works. I just... I need to return something. I'm so disappointed.

Thank you for holding. My name is David. I can certainly help you today. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's the new aero helmet I bought. It’s more of a preference thing, I guess. The color just isn't what it looked like online. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I just feel awful about this. The box is still unopened, I haven't even taken it out.

I understand completely. Getting the right color is important, and we want you to be confident in your gear. After all, the primary function of a helmet is your safety, and you should feel good wearing it. Let me just pull up your account.
Okay, I see the order here. It looks like it was delivered 44 days ago. That's no problem at all.
Oh, I was so worried it had been too long. I really needed this money back. Are you sure it's okay?

Absolutely. Our policy for standard items like this helmet is a 90-day return window. Since you're well within that timeframe and you mentioned the box is unopened, I can approve this return for a full refund right now.
Oh, thank goodness! That is such a relief. Thank you so much, David. You've really helped me out.

You are very welcome. I'm happy we could get this sorted for you. I've just emailed you a prepaid shipping label. Just attach that to the original box and drop it at your local post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
